correctness.rationale: For idempotent maps e,f, the image of e∘f is e(im f). Its root a in an occupied e-kernel fiber is fixed exactly when f(a) stays in that fiber. The proof partitions e-kernel blocks into empty, occupied-with-root-fixed, and occupied-with-root-moving cases, with locally reversible weights s z exp(s z), v x z exp((s+x) z), and v x z^2 exp((s+x) z). The exponential formula and coefficient extraction give the n!/[(r-t)!t!(s-t)!] coefficient and precisely n−r−s+t. All support inequalities are necessary and sufficient. The verifier independently enumerates all pairs for n≤6 and independently counts by f-root subsets for n≤4. No finite enumeration is substituted for the general proof.

value.rationale: Whether a product of idempotents remains idempotent is a central, order-sensitive feature of the biordered set of a transformation semigroup and of skew-pair theory. The formula gives a complete three-invariant census (ranks of both factors and their idempotent product) in every degree, including noncommuting pairs, rather than a routine rank-one slice or small numerical gain. It separates a strict subset from the older commuting case (n=3: 94 versus 58), and supplies exact support conditions and a finite-sum expression usable for probability and comparison of product behavior. It does not assert a large downstream theorem.
